title: Focus-trapped modal
label: Overlay · focus management
summary: A dialog that keeps focus inside while open, closes with Esc, and hands focus back to whatever opened it.
use_when: A short task must be finished or dismissed before going back, such as confirming a delete or a two-field form
avoid_when: Long forms, content people want to compare with the page, or anything that could be its own page or an inline message
